C-DOCS-SYNC.Summary: Docs-and-records wave 13: synchronize documentation, notices and GRACE records with the shipped truth — correct the file-icons license entry in the node notices (oss F-002), give questions a direct route from README and the issue menu (oss F-004), stop duplicating a stale Wrangler version in the gateway README (ai-readiness F-007), repoint stale .grace/changes/active links to the archived bundles (ai-readiness F-008), name the real external-reload module and checks in M-032/V-M-032 (cognitive F-001), align the release-notes section with the prerelease channel rules (cognitive F-002), describe the live-reload guards in the README promise and guides (cognitive F-003), record the restored-cursor exclusion in V-M-063 (cognitive F-006), and fix the three doubled Cargo manifest paths in verification commands (ai-readiness F-009). Every item re-verified against the current tree on 2026-11-21; stale audit items are dropped in Relationship with the fixing evidence.
C-DOCS-SYNC.Problem: From the 2026-11-20 audits (oss-readiness 85/100 at be2f52f; ai-readiness 65/100 and cognitive-debt 62/100 at 35c9223), the following remain true in the current tree: (oss F-002) NOTICES-node.md:454-458 lists file-icons 2.1.47 under "UNLICENSED (1)" while package-lock.json:6666-6669 records "license": "MIT" for the same pinned revision (git+ssh file-icons/atom#2852086) — the generator tools/build-notices-node.mjs copies license-checker's UNLICENSED verbatim for git-hosted deps whose installed metadata lacks a license field, so every regenerated notice and release asset repeats the wrong license. (oss F-004) README.md Contributing (220-228) names bugs, ideas, security and the docs site but not the public Q&A category, and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml offers only Documentation and Security contact links, so an ordinary usage question has no pointed route (blank issues disabled). (ai F-007) tools/stats-gateway/README.md:185 states "The dedicated manifest pins Wrangler 4.159.0" while the manifest pins 4.162.0 (tools/stats-gateway/package.json devDependencies) — the very next instruction tells the reader to verify the installed version, which now mismatches the prose. (ai F-008) seven source contracts and one tool still LINK to packages under .grace/changes/active that have moved to .grace/changes/archive: tableResize/index.js:7 (C-TABLE-LAYOUT-COMPLETION), tableLayoutSchema.js:7 and tableLayoutRatios.js:7 (C-TABLE-PROFILE-SCHEMA), editor.js:2533 and externalReload.js:7 (C-EXTERNAL-RELOAD-OPERATION), recentlyClosed.js:21 (C-FIX-009-RECENTLY-CLOSED), editors-bench.sh:11 (C-14), plus the self-expiring notes in stats-gateway query.mjs:22, tables.mjs:15 and worker.mjs:42,46 (C-STATS-READOUT, C-STATS-DASH-PUSH) whose "moves under archive when the change archives" condition has come due — all ten targets confirmed present under archive. (cognitive F-001) the M-032 live-reload card (graph/features.xml 160-202) names only editor.js/preferences.js as its paths and omits util/externalReload.js — the module that owns reload admission, re-confirmation and replacement — and V-M-032 (verification/features.xml 653-664) lists no external-reload test file, so the documented route from contract to module to checks is broken at both ends. (cognitive F-002) docs/release-process.md contradicts itself: section 4a (90-107, freshly restated by the approved C-RELEASE-BETA-CHECKS-GATE) says a prerelease "never becomes releases/latest: the in-app updater feed stays on the previous stable tag", while section 5 (109-129) instructs editing notes on a "v2.X.Y-beta" tag and asserts beta tags are published with --prerelease=false "so /releases/latest advances for the in-app updater" — the exact failure a maintainer was told in 4a not to expect, plus a tag format section 4a does not mint. (cognitive F-003) README.md:62 promises "Every save on disk reloads the tab in place and keeps your scroll position", the --watch row (README.md:189) says "Reload the file whenever it changes on disk, even if live reload is off", and both guides repeat it (static/guide/en.md:14 "every save reloads the page", ru.md:14) — none mentions the shipped guards (clean tab required, explicit choice before unsaved content is replaced, identical-content skip), so users can read the promise as "my unsaved edits may be discarded silently" and maintainers as "this path may be weakened". (cognitive F-006) the V-M-063 unmounted-tail scenario (verification/performance.xml 1670-1679) lists "restored remembered cursor position" among navigations that land through the on-demand mount, while the approved C-LARGE-DOC-WAVE-A owner decision (b) (archive owner-decision.md 82-90) keeps cursor/cache-restore opens LEGACY and editor-progressive-mount.test.js:748 pins that exclusion — the scenario demands what the contract forbids. (ai F-009) three verification commands double the manifest directory — runtime.xml:1119 (cargo test … search), :2381 (… menu), :9695 (… pandoc) each read "cd src-tauri && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml …", which resolves to the nonexistent src-tauri/src-tauri/Cargo.toml.

Goals.Goal: oss F-002 — honest file-icons notice: the committed NOTICES-node.md shows file-icons 2.1.47 as MIT with the upstream license reference, and the generator produces exactly that on regeneration (a pinned name@version → license/URL override for git-hosted deps whose detection fails, sourced from the lockfile), so the CI verify-attributions regeneration diff stays clean and the next release asset carries the correct license.

oss F-004 — a route for questions: README's Contributing section and the issue-template contact links both point to the public GitHub Discussions Q&A category alongside the existing bug/idea/security routes, so a reader can tell a question from an error report from a confidential message.

ai F-007 — one Wrangler version: the gateway README stops quoting a version number and defers to the manifest/lockfile it already tells the reader to install from (4.162.0 today); the check step keeps comparing the installed CLI against the manifest.

ai F-008 — links land in the archive: every stale .grace/changes/active/… LINK in the ten listed files points at the package's actual archive path (same filenames, no content rewrites); the stats-gateway self-expiring notes resolve to their now-current archive locations.

cognitive F-001 — the updater route names the real module: the M-032 card names util/externalReload.js as the admission/replacement module with store/editor.js as the entry point, and V-M-032's commands include the module's targeted suites (tests/renderer/util/external-reload.test.js and the store live-reload suite it already lists), so contract → module → checks is walkable.

cognitive F-002 — the release doc speaks with one voice about channels: section 5 uses a supported stable tag in its examples, drops the "--prerelease=false so /releases/latest advances" claim for betas, and states the per-channel observable outcome already defined in section 4a (prerelease: latest stays on the previous stable; stable: latest advances and the feed serves the new version).

cognitive F-003 — the promise includes its guards: README's watch paragraph, the --watch flag row and both guides say when the automatic reload happens (clean tab; explicit confirmation before unsaved edits are replaced) so the text matches the shipped conflict-choice contract without turning into a manual.

cognitive F-006 — V-M-063 matches the owner decision: the unmounted-tail scenario no longer claims restored-cursor (or blocks-cache) opens mount progressively; it references the legacy-path exception and the pinning test instead.

ai F-009 — runnable Rust checks: the three search/menu/pandoc commands in .grace/verification/runtime.xml use a manifest path consistent with their working directory (manifest-path from the repo root, or a bare cargo test after cd src-tauri), so each runs as written.

Constraints.Constraint: Docs-and-records only: no product code, no workflow, no dependency, no version bump. The one generator touched (tools/build-notices-node.mjs) changes only how the license column is derived for undetectable git-hosted deps — the committed NOTICES-node.md and its regeneration must move together because tools/verify-attributions.sh diffs them in CI.

Graph and verification edits are governance maintenance, not rewrites: M-032/V-M-032 get the minimal truthful additions (module name, path, test commands, scenario exception text); no scenario, priority, marker or assertion is deleted; frozen docs/*.xml, docs/migrations/** and archived change bundles stay untouched.
docs/release-process.md section 4a is the authoritative prerelease truth (just restated by the approved C-RELEASE-BETA-CHECKS-GATE); section 5 is aligned to it, never the reverse.
English-only text edits follow the public artifact format voice; the guides stay consistent between en.md and ru.md (deliberate localization exceptions excepted).
GRACE bookkeeping synchronized: any touched source-file header (LINKS lines) gets a CHANGE_SUMMARY line where the file carries one; grace current assertions stay green before and after.

NonGoals.NonGoal: License compliance work beyond the file-icons label: the chardet LGPL-3.0 distribution review stays an owner/legal decision (oss audit, separate track).

Any change to updater, release workflow or prerelease lane behaviour; this wave edits only how the docs describe them.
